description: Use this when: you have opened a canvas with canvas_open and want to show the user what you are explaining. Actions: filter {only_full, billing, providers}; exclude {offer_ids}; sort {by: cost|name|provider}; compare {offer_ids, 2 to 4} puts plans side by side and charts their cost by volume; highlight {offer_ids, note}; explain {text} adds your explanation to the canvas, marked as yours; what_if {change: search fields} asks the engine again with changed conditions (a budget goes here as max_monthly_cost_usd; a field set to null is removed; at most 6 per canvas); chart {kind: cost_by_volume|none}; reset. Returns the new summary. Read each shown plan's fails and not_stated before using what_if.
name: canvas_do
title: Change what the canvas shows
